conventions.name: feature-slice-roots
conventions.description: Feature directories are ownership boundaries, not file buckets.

conventions.name: feature-slice-layers
conventions.description: Feature implementation files live below an explicit layer directory.

conventions.name: widget-slice-roots
conventions.description: Widget directories expose composition and interaction through named layers.

conventions.name: widget-components-live-under-layers
conventions.description: Widget React components are placed in ui or rsc layers, never at the slice root.

conventions.name: feature-components-live-under-layers
conventions.description: Feature React components are placed in ui or another semantic layer, never at the slice root.

conventions.name: tsx-files-use-pascal-case
conventions.description: Client, server, and UI React components use PascalCase filenames.

conventions.name: tsx-files-have-no-separators
conventions.description: React component filenames do not use kebab-case or snake_case separators.

conventions.name: ts-modules-use-camel-case
conventions.description: Non-component TypeScript modules use camelCase filenames.

conventions.name: route-reserved-files
conventions.description: Funstack route entrypoints remain explicit reserved filenames.
